<style class="gs-fixes">
/* Fix round 1 (BUGS A2/A5): the 7 cosmetics below moved out of meta/overrides.json.
   Overrides are a single client-side pass at DOMContentLoaded, so they flash
   un-applied on slow mobile and never reach innerHTML-rebuilt nodes.
   Rule order and selectors follow the specificity table in WP-F1. */
/* 1 */ .sf-notice{display:none}
/* 2 */ :root{--sf-notice-h:0px}
/* 3 - P0 contrast fix: the template paints white text on lime (1.31:1).
       .sf-header.scrolled is (0,2,0), so it is covered explicitly. */
.sf-header,.sf-header.scrolled{background:#fff;color:#194536}
/* 4 - ID-scoped: the funnel injects its CSS in-body, so ties are not safe */
#orderFunnel{--of-green:#194536;--of-green-d:#0f3527;--of-lime:#C4F139}
/* 5 - background shorthand, not background-color: it must clear the gradient */
#orderFunnel .of-offer{background:#194536}
/* 6 */ #orderFunnel .of-dd__gift{color:#194536}
/* 7 - static CSS also reaches the nodes applyPeriod() rebuilds (the A2 fix) */
#orderFunnel .of-gift-accent{color:#194536}
</style>
